name: Raider squat
description: A covetous crew squatting past a settler's fence-line — THE HEARTH WATCH's event camp (living-frontier Phase 4). Never rolls on its own (weight 0); only the raid dice stand one, always tied to the hearth it covets (originCell hearth:<characterId>), facing the claim. Small, craven, and temporary by design: it harasses, it never breaches.
